crossRefs.note: As for me, I will call on God. Yahweh will save me.
But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.
Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.
Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
Behold, and answer me, Yahweh, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;
lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.
Turn your ear, Yahweh, and hear. Open your eyes, Yahweh, and behold. Hear all of the words of Sennacherib, who has sent…
Now therefore, Yahweh our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you are Yahweh…
“Now therefore, our God, listen to the prayer of your servant, and to his petitions, and cause your face to shine on…

translations.web: I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.
translations.bsb: I call on You, O God, for You will answer me. Incline Your ear to me; hear my words.
translations.kjv: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.
translations.asv: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt answer me, O God: Incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.
